source_audits.publisher: Greater London Authority / London planning authorities
source_audits.source_type: official planning application and lifecycle API
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: London Datastore dataset page lists Licence: Not Specified as checked on 2026-05-19. This scratch pack keeps factual row metadata, official row/API URLs, normalized coordinates, attribution, and retrieval date only. Review terms before bulk redistribution.
source_audits.coverage_years: Rows queried where actual_commencement_date or actual_completion_date falls from 2008-01-01 through 2026-05-19.
source_audits.update_frequency: Daily according to the London Datastore dataset page checked on 2026-05-19.
source_audits.geographic_scope: Greater London planning authorities represented in the PLD guest applications API, filtered to a Greater London coordinate envelope.
source_audits.granularity: Application-row lifecycle dates with source row id, LPA reference, centroid or polygon-derived representative point.
required_caveats: actual_commencement_date and actual_completion_date are source-reported administrative/applicant/local-authority feed fields, not independent proof of construction start, construction completion, opening, occupation, current use, final built form, design quality, outcomes, or causation.
Feed completeness, date semantics, and geometry availability vary by borough system.
Coordinates support atlas navigation only; use source planning documents for site or phase boundaries.
Licence for the applications dataset is Not Specified, so downstream use should preserve attribution and source links and avoid bulk reproduction without terms review.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use selected rows as documented planning lifecycle milestones only, with inline limitations and no claims about delivery outcomes.

source_audits.source_type: official API access path for Planning London Datahub application rows
source_audits.license_or_terms_note: Same terms caveat as the GLA applications dataset; retain official row ids and URLs.
source_audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use as source-row retrieval/provenance URL, not as a standalone claim source without the row fields.
